bias.label: Bounce to 3,600; still leaning down below 3,650

event: Mon 23 Nov 16:45 SAST: US flash PMI, plus Chicago Fed index and Fed speakers. Wed 25 Nov 15:30 SAST: US PCE, GDP, durable goods, jobless claims. Thu 26 Nov: US Thanksgiving, thin trade. Fed decision 9 Dec.

bullets.title: Strong Monday bounce
bullets.text: Mitrade put spot gold near 3,604 on Monday morning, up from Friday's 3,538 close; the exact time of that price is UNVERIFIED.

bullets.title: Stocks in correction
bullets.text: The S&P 500 fell 3.7% and the Nasdaq 5.3% last week on AI-stock selling, which is now pulling some money into gold.

bullets.title: Yields easing
bullets.text: The US 10-year yield slipped to about 4.94%, which lowers the cost of holding gold.

bullets.title: Fed hike still priced
bullets.text: CME FedWatch shows about a 93% chance of a quarter-point hike on 9 December, down from about 99%, so talk of a bigger hike is fading.

bullets.title: Trend still down
bullets.text: Gold lost about 9% last week, and 3,630-3,650 is the first real ceiling, so this bounce has not changed the bigger trend yet.

bullets.title: Data-heavy week
bullets.text: Flash PMI is tonight at 16:45 SAST, and PCE and GDP land Wednesday at 15:30 SAST before the US holiday.
